name: nodemaven
description: Residential proxies for scraping and automation: proxy setup and geo-targeting, the Python, Rust and Go SDKs, the account API, Google SERP scraping, proxy benchmarking and troubleshooting, plus a read-only MCP server for the account.

api_key.title: NodeMaven API key
api_key.description: Dashboard API key, used by the MCP server for account status, traffic statistics, locations, sub-users and whitelisted IPs. Not the proxy password.
